method.first_meaningful: direct wall time to first non-empty text or complete tool-call stream event
method.tool_ready: direct wall time to the first complete executable tool-call event
method.first_event_bytes: wall time to the first non-empty NDJSON stream line
method.total: wall time through stream close after the final done event
method.prediction_scope: Text TTFT predicts base plus prefill. Buffered tool readiness and total duration add independently estimated completion tokens divided by decode throughput.
method.cache_control: cache_prompt=false and a per-run, per-sample prefix prevent prior or within-run prefix reuse; cached counts are recorded without exclusions.
